title: Diablo outreach channels
about: Every outreach channel: the ones research runs today and the new ones suggested on 22 Oct 2026, from Ariel's product certificates sheet (92 products; the sheet itself was not changed). type_in_button_2 is what to type in the Channels box of button 2 (2 - Research). ready_to_run says whether today's research rules handle it, or it needs its own rule sheet first. From 22 Oct 2026 'Add a market' searches every channel in config/coverage.json (the list the research uses); this file stays the reference.
